# marginal BPOT

```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
source('../scripts/fitBPOT.R')
ci_severe_20_M <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_marginal,q1=x0,q2=20)
ci_severe_30_M <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_marginal,q1=x0,q2=30)
ci_severe_40_M <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_marginal,q1=x0,q2=40)
ci_severe_50_M <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_marginal,q1=x0,q2=50)
```

# Joint BPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
source('../scripts/fitBPOT_joint.R')

all_bpot_models <- lapply(all_bpot_results, function(x) x$M)
ci_severe_20_J <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_joint,q1=x0,q2=20)
ci_severe_30_J <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_joint,q1=x0,q2=30)
ci_severe_40_J <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_joint,q1=x0,q2=40)
ci_severe_50_J <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_sim_joint,q1=x0,q2=50)

# marginal vs joint BPOT estimation on the same figure
plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(Marginal = ci_severe_20_M, Joint = ci_severe_20_J),
                         ylab = "P(TTC<0, Speed>20 km/h)",
                         filename = "ci_severe_prob_20.png")
plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(Marginal = ci_severe_30_M, Joint = ci_severe_30_J),
                         ylab = "P(TTC<0, Speed>30 km/h)",
                         filename = "ci_severe_prob_30.png")
plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(Marginal = ci_severe_40_M, Joint = ci_severe_40_J),
                         ylab = "P(TTC<0, Speed>40 km/h)",
                         filename = "ci_severe_prob_40.png")
plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(Marginal = ci_severe_50_M, Joint = ci_severe_50_J),
                         ylab = "P(TTC<0, Speed>50 km/h)",
                         filename = "ci_severe_prob_50.png")
```

# CBPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

ci_severe_20 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_sim,x0=x0,y0=20)
ci_severe_30 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_sim,x0=x0,y0=30)
ci_severe_40 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_sim,x0=x0,y0=40)
ci_severe_50 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_sim,x0=x0,y0=50)

plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(CBPOT = ci_severe_20),
                         ylab="Q(TTC<0, Speed>20 km/h)",
                         filename = "cbpot_ci_severe_prob_20.png")
plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(CBPOT = ci_severe_30),
                         ylab="Q(TTC<0, Speed>30 km/h)",
                         filename = "cbpot_ci_severe_prob_30.png")
plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(CBPOT = ci_severe_40),
                         ylab="Q(TTC<0, Speed>40 km/h)",
                         filename = "cbpot_ci_severe_prob_40.png")
plot_prob_ci_box_grouped(list(CBPOT = ci_severe_50),
                         ylab="Q(TTC<0, Speed>50 km/h)",
                         filename = "cbpot_ci_severe_prob_50.png")
```

# best BPOT and CBPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
best_bpot <- sapply(11:50, function(x) ci_bpot_sim_marginal(alog_M,q1=x0,q2=x)) %>% 
  t() %>% cbind(11:50) %>% as.data.frame()

suboptimal_bpot <- sapply(11:50, function(x) ci_bpot_sim_marginal(log_M,q1=x0,q2=x)) %>% 
  t() %>% cbind(11:50) %>% as.data.frame()
ggplot(data = best_bpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),alpha=0.2) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="P(TTC<0,Speed>threshold)") +
  theme_bw()

best_cbpot <- sapply(1:50, function(x) ci_cbpot_sim(frank_M,x0=x0,y0=x)) %>% 
  t() %>% cbind(1:50) %>% as.data.frame()

ggplot(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),alpha=0.2) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="P(TTC<0,Speed>threshold)") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = best_bpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate,color="asymmetric logistic")) + 
  geom_ribbon(data = best_bpot, aes(x=V4,ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill="asymmetric logistic"),alpha=0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.5),linetype=3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.9),linetype=3) +
  geom_line(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate,color="frank copula")) + 
  geom_ribbon(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill="frank copula"),alpha=0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = v,linetype=2) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="P(Speed>threshold , TTC <0)") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Model", values = c("asymmetric logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c("asymmetric logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("../plots/prob_ci_cont.png",device = "png", width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = suboptimal_bpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate,color="logistic")) + 
  geom_ribbon(data = suboptimal_bpot, aes(x=V4,ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill="logistic"),alpha=0.2) +
  geom_line(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate,color="frank copula")) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.5),linetype=3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.9),linetype=3) +
  geom_ribbon(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill="frank copula"),alpha=0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = v,linetype=2) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="P(Speed>threshold , TTC <0)") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Model", values = c("logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c("logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("../plots/prob_ci_cont2.png",device = "png", width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=frank_M$plot_df_q,aes(speed,ConditionalD,color="frank copula")) + 
  geom_line(data=alog_M$plot_df,aes(speed,ConditionalD,,color="asymmetric logistic")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.5),linetype=3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.9),linetype=3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = max(Dat$Speed),linetype=3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = v,linetype=2) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Model", values = c("asymmetric logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="f(Speed | TTC <0)") +
  xlim(c(0,50))+
  theme_bw()
ggsave("../plots/density_compare.png",device = "png", width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=frank_M$plot_df_q,aes(speed,ConditionalD,color="frank copula")) + 
  geom_line(data=log_M$plot_df,aes(speed,ConditionalD,,color="logistic")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.5),linetype=3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(Dat$Speed,0.9),linetype=3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = v,linetype=2) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Model", values = c("logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="f(Speed | TTC <0)") +
  xlim(c(0,50))+
  theme_bw()
ggsave("../plots/density_compare.png",device = "png", width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)


```
